description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Orders of the maximum retail prices on Mysore Dhal, Dried Sprats, Green Moong, white sugar & imported potatoes w.e.f. 27.01.2017
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, setting maximum retail prices for specific consumer goods. It represents regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure change or any other specialized category.
